messages:
Leah: Heads-up — Q4 GTM planning: we need final decisions on launch gating for Predictive Cache by Friday. Two customer asks: Acme wants per-tenant routing, Nova is ok with telemetry-only. Quick poll: MVP telemetry-only or add customer config? Context below.

Jon: Lean telemetry-only to hit dates. Sales needs a Nov 10 ship to keep ACME negotiation momentum. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ravi: Telemetry-only is ~2x simpler infra-wise. Per-tenant config introduces auth, RBAC, audit logs, and extra e2e tests — estimates look like +3 sprints.

Nina: If we ship telemetry-only, marketing will frame it as "beta: admin config coming soon". We can run a PLG onboarding experiment (A/B) to measure conversion.

Sasha: ACME specifically asked for tenant routing in initial ask. Nova is flexible. If we delay, ACME might push the deal out. We might do a single-customer canary.

Leah: Options — A) Telemetry-only MVP (Nov launch) B) Full tenant-config (delayed to Jan) C) Canary: one-customer toggle + telemetry (compromise). Please rank/vote.

Michael: +1 for C) single-customer toggle. Safer from ops perspective and enables ACME proof-of-concept. :thumbsup:

Jon: Vote: C — will support with ACME comms.

Ravi: Vote: A — engineering prefers minimal surface area to reduce risk.

Nina: Vote: C — gives a marketing story and early case study.

Sasha: Vote: C, but require dedicated SRE oncall the week of launch.

Leah: Noted. Draft launch gating criteria (proposed):

```
- Core telemetry pipeline ingesting at target QPS with <5% error rate
- Canary toggle deployable for a single tenant via feature-flag with audit trail
- Latency impact on token-serving path < 8ms P95 in canary window
- End-to-end test coverage for toggle + rollback script validated in staging
- Docs + admin UI stub for enabling feature (basic)
- Legal sign-off for customer data usage (telemetry)
```

Leah: Action items: @Ravi - provide story-point estimate for tenant-config and single-customer toggle by Wed. @Sasha - confirm ACME willingness to be canary customer by Thurs. @Jon - push for 1-week extension if ACME needs tenant-config. @Nina - prep PLG experiment hypothesis and copy for "beta" messaging.

deploy-bot: Reminder: roadmap doc updated — new draft available in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/RC-2332 :bookmark:

Leah: OK — leaning toward C based on votes. I'll update the roadmap draft and OKR tracker. Meeting to finalize Friday 10:00am PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
